definition.zh-TW: 營業毛利占營業收入的比例，看商品本身的賺頭。數值越高表示進貨成本相對越低、定價空間越大。
definition.en: Gross profit as a share of revenue: the margin in the goods themselves. Higher means purchase costs are relatively lower and there is more pricing room.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
